Method of Attack: Malicious RTF documents exploiting Follina (CVE-2022-30190) vulnerability in Microsoft's MSDT to achieve remote code execution
Use of typo-squatted domains to lure victims via spear-phishing
Loading backdoor malware (x64 DLL named 'Calc.exe') that connects to C2 servers for commands including data exfiltration, downloading payloads, deleting files, spawning processes, and reverse shell
Impacted Systems: Windows systems vulnerable to Follina exploit
Attack Vector: Spear-phishing with malicious documents from typo-squatted Ukrainian World Congress website
Indicators of Compromise: Typo-squatted '.info' domain mimicking Ukrainian World Congress '.org' site
